lines.en: label nikidate5:
I tap on Niki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Niki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: Given that it’s her actual number this time and I won’t need to go through a third party in order to talk to her, I’m feeling a bit optimistic.
lines.zh: 这次是她的真实号码，我不用再通过第三方才能跟她说上话，所以我有点乐观。

lines.en: I mean, I’ve grown pretty accustomed to never being turned down to begin with, but if it was ever going to happen, it was going to be because of that manager of hers.
lines.zh: 我是说，我早就习惯了从来不会被拒绝，但如果真要被拒，那肯定是因为她那个经纪人。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey. What are you doing tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今晚在干嘛？

lines.en: : Being famous. Why?
lines.zh: : 当名人啊。怎么？

lines.en: : Are you going to remind me of how famous you are every time we talk?
lines.zh: : 你每次跟我说话都要提醒我一下你有多红吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. I’ll stop once you acknowledge me.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。等你承认了我就停。

lines.en: : You’re so famous and I’m so glad to know you.
lines.zh: : 你太红了，认识你我真高兴。

lines.en: : Once you acknowledge me {i}for real!{/i}
lines.zh: : 要你{i}真心实意地{/i}承认！

lines.en: : Oh. That might still be a ways off.
lines.zh: : 哦。那大概还得等一阵子。

lines.en: : Do you need something or are you just calling to remind me that you’re unimpressed by the huge strides I’ve made as both a person and a woman?
lines.zh: : 你是有事找我，还是专门打电话来提醒我，你对我作为一个女人、也作为一个人所取得的巨大进步毫不在意？

lines.en: : Women are people too, Niki. Don’t say things like that.
lines.zh: : 女人也是人啊，Niki。别这么说。

lines.en: : That’s not what I meant! Stop being an asshole or I’ll hang up!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思！别当混蛋了，不然我挂了！

lines.en: : You wouldn’t hang up on-
lines.zh: : 你不会挂我——

lines.en: Did she...actually hang up on me?
lines.zh: 她……还真挂我电话了？

lines.en: I tap on Niki’s name {i}again{/i} and wait for her to answer {i}again.{/i}
lines.zh: 我{i}又一次{/i}点下 Niki 的名字，{i}又一次{/i}等她接听。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 去你的。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I won’t mess with you.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我不逗你了。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking- if you're going to invite me out, just do it already!
lines.zh: : 我操——你要约我出去就直说！

lines.en: : That’s why you’re calling, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你打电话来不就是为了这个吗？

lines.en: : Didn’t we decide on breakfast as our reconnecting meal? You’re not just waking up now, are you?
lines.zh: : 我们不是定好了早餐作为重修旧好的那一餐吗？你该不会是刚睡醒吧？

lines.en: : I have been awake for quite some time. And yes, this is me asking you out right now.
lines.zh: : 我已经醒了有一阵子了。对，我现在就是在约你。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 行吧。

lines.en: : I want soba noodles.
lines.zh: : 我想吃荞麦面。

lines.en: : What places do you know that sell soba?
lines.zh: : 你知道哪家店卖荞麦面？

lines.en: : I can...look one up?
lines.zh: : 我……可以查一下？

lines.en: : Okay. Text me when you figure it out.
lines.zh: : 好。查到了发我。

lines.en: : I don’t need to pick you up or anything?
lines.zh: : 不用我去接你什么的吗？

lines.en: : Wait, did you actually learn how to drive?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真学会开车了？

lines.en: : No. I was offering to walk by and physically carry you to-
lines.zh: : 没有。我是在提议顺路走过去，然后直接把你扛到——

lines.en: Wow.
lines.zh: 哇。

lines.en: She really doesn’t take any shit from me, does she?
lines.zh: 她还真是一点都不吃我那套啊。

lines.en: She’s like a real ex-girlfriend.
lines.zh: 就跟真的前女友一样。

lines.en: scene black
Well, I guess she technically {i}is{/i} a real ex-girlfriend...but it still doesn’t seem very real to me.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想严格来说她{i}确实是{/i}真的前女友……可我还是觉得这事不太真实。

lines.en: I’ve already learned a little about the past from Noriko, but...
lines.zh: 我已经从 Noriko 那儿听了一点过去的事，不过……

lines.en: If anyone {i}really{/i} knows anything about the original Sensei, wouldn’t it be Niki?
lines.zh: 要说{i}真的{/i}有谁了解原来那个 Sensei，那不应该是 Niki 吗？

lines.en: Even if it’s something as simple as...
lines.zh: 哪怕是像……这么简单的事。

lines.en: scene nikidinner1
: You...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: : I forgot how old I am. Please tell me.
lines.zh: : 我忘了自己多大了。告诉我。

lines.en: As you can see, I’ve decided to ask Niki some baseline questions to really establish who I am “supposed to be” as a person.
lines.zh: 如你所见，我决定问 Niki 一些最基本的问题，好真正确立我作为一个人“应该”是谁。

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: As you can see, she does not like that very much.
lines.zh: 如你所见，她对此非常不买账。

lines.en: : How many times are you going to try and get me to do something stupid for your silly candid reality show thing?
lines.zh: : 你到底要试多少次，才能让我为你那个愚蠢的整人真人秀节目做点傻事？

lines.en: : There is no show. I just genuinely don’t know how old I am...
lines.zh: : 没有什么节目。我是真的不知道自己多大了……

lines.en: scene nikidinner2
: Then look at your ID! You’re a grown man! You can’t rely on me for things like this!
lines.zh: : 那就看你的身份证！你是个成年男人了！这种事你不能依赖我！

lines.en: : Funny story. I actually lost my ID.
lines.zh: : 说来好笑。我把身份证弄丢了。

lines.en: : That’s not funny! It’s inconvenient! Those things are really annoying to replace!
lines.zh: : 那一点都不好笑！那很麻烦！那玩意儿补办起来烦死了！

lines.en: : So you don’t know?
lines.zh: : 所以你不知道？

lines.en: scene nikidinner3
: Of course I know, idiot.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道，白痴。

lines.en: : {i}I just don’t want to say it because it will remind me of how old I am.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是不想说，因为那会提醒我自己有多老。{/i}

lines.en: : Are we the same age?
lines.zh: : 我们同岁吗？

lines.en: : You’re two years older than me.
lines.zh: : 你比我大两岁。

lines.en: : There’s no way I’m only two years older than you.
lines.zh: : 我不可能只比你大两岁。

lines.en: scene nikidinner4
: There is a way! And even that two year gap was annoying in [high_school]!
lines.zh: : 就是有可能！而且就算只差两岁，在 [high_school] 的时候也很烦人！

lines.en: : I only got to spend one year in[school] with you and no one ever believed I was dating an older guy when I told them about it!
lines.zh: : 我在[school]里只和你同校过一年，我跟别人说我在跟一个年纪更大的男生交往，根本没人信！

lines.en: : I mean...two years older isn’t {i}that{/i} much older.
lines.zh: : 我是说……大两岁也没大{i}多少{/i}吧。

lines.en: : It is when you’re in [high_school]!
lines.zh: : 在 [high_school] 的时候就是大很多！

lines.en: : Niki, I think you should probably stop yelling.
lines.zh: : Niki，我觉得你大概该别喊了。

lines.en: scene nikidinner5
: I’M ON TV! I CAN YELL WHENEVER I WANT!
lines.zh: : 我上电视了！我想什么时候喊就什么时候喊！

lines.en: : Aren’t you the one who said you didn’t want to attract any attention?
lines.zh: : 不是你自己说不想引起任何注意的吗？

lines.en: scene nikidinner6
: Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啦……

lines.en: : I’m just annoyed you’re still keeping up this stupid amnesia thing.
lines.zh: : 我只是很火大，你还在继续玩这个愚蠢的失忆把戏。

lines.en: : Pretending to forget your age...pretending to forget {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 假装忘了自己的年纪……假装忘了{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s all really fucking frustrating after I spent years worrying about you.
lines.zh: : 在我为你操了那么多年的心之后，这一切真的他妈的让人抓狂。

lines.en: : And I haven’t even gotten an actual apology yet.
lines.zh: : 而我到现在连一个真正的道歉都没收到。

lines.en: : You’ll get one as soon as I’m able to be sincere about it.
lines.zh: : 等我能真心诚意地道歉，你就会收到了。

lines.en: : So you can dump me after five years and leave me to rot but you can’t even fork over an actual apology.
lines.zh: : 所以你可以在谈了五年之后甩了我、丢下我自生自灭，却连一句真正的道歉都掏不出来。

lines.en: : Can we get the check now? I don’t want to be here anymore.
lines.zh: : 我们现在能买单了吗？我不想待在这儿了。

lines.en: : I can’t be sincere because there really is something...{i}wrong{/i} with my memory.
lines.zh: : 我没法真心诚意，因为我的记忆真的……有点{i}问题{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s not amnesia, per se...but it’s like...
lines.zh: : 严格来说那不是失忆症……而是像……

lines.en: : It’s like I’m a different person occupying this body.
lines.zh: : 像是换了一个人住在这具身体里。

lines.en: scene nikidinner7
: Bullshit.
lines.zh: : 放屁。

lines.en: : You’re exactly the same way you’ve always been. Just taller and...with a thicker T-shirt.
lines.zh: : 你跟你一直以来一模一样。只是高了点……T 恤厚了点。

lines.en: : Thank you for noticing the T-shirt. No one ever does.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你注意到了 T 恤。从来没人注意到。

lines.en: scene nikidinner8
: What I’m saying is if there is anyone out there who would be able to catch if you were magically a different person or whatever, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果这世上真有谁能看出你有没有被魔法换成另一个人之类的，那就是我。

lines.en: : We grew up together. Shit, you basically lived at my house.
lines.zh: : 我们是一起长大的。靠，你基本上就住在我家。

lines.en: : And I feel like an idiot for ever believing it but, for a long time, I was pretty sure I was going to spend the rest of my life with you.
lines.zh: : 我真傻，居然曾经相信过——有很长一段时间，我挺确定自己是要跟你过一辈子的。

lines.en: scene nikidinner9
: But now I’m famous and cute and you’re a loser so HA.
lines.zh: : 但现在我又红又可爱，而你是个废物，所以哈。

lines.en: : Chance is gone, pal.
lines.zh: : 机会没了，伙计。

lines.en: That can’t be right.
lines.zh: 这不可能对。

lines.en: Even if Niki and Sensei {i}did{/i} spend that much time together, what about all of the time they didn’t?
lines.zh: 就算 Niki 和 Sensei {i}真的{/i}在一起待了那么久，那他们没在一起的时间呢？

lines.en: It’s highly possible- no. Highly {i}probable{/i} that he changed as years went by.
lines.zh: 很有可能——不，{i}极有可能{/i}，他随着年岁增长变了。

lines.en: And then, for some reason I still don’t quite understand, I wound up taking his place.
lines.zh: 然后，出于某种我到现在都还没完全理解的理由，我顶替了他的位置。

lines.en: And not just me, but seemingly countless other people if we’re going by what Maya says.
lines.zh: 而且不只我，如果按 Maya 的说法，似乎还有数不清的其他人。

lines.en: But what if Maya’s wrong?
lines.zh: 可如果 Maya 错了呢？

lines.en: And what if Niki’s wrong?
lines.zh: 如果 Niki 也错了呢？

lines.en: What if I’m wrong?
lines.zh: 如果我错了呢？

lines.en: : God, this is so fucking confusing.
lines.zh: : 天哪，这真他妈让人糊涂。

lines.en: scene nikidinner10
: What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : You know I’m just messing around with you, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我只是在逗你玩，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re not a loser.
lines.zh: : 你不是废物。

lines.en: : Noriko says you finally became a real teacher. So I guess your dreams came true to at least some extent.
lines.zh: : Noriko 说你总算当上了真正的老师。所以你的梦想至少实现了一部分。

lines.en: : I just mean this whole memory thing.
lines.zh: : 我只是说这个记忆的事。

lines.en: : I don’t even know if I want what you’re saying to be true or not.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道自己想不想让你说的是真的。

lines.en: : Why on earth would you not want to be yourself?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么不想做你自己？

lines.en: : Because if that’s true, it’s going to be a lot harder to justify why I can’t remember anything past the last several months.
lines.zh: : 因为如果那是真的，我就更难解释，为什么过去几个月之前的事我什么都不记得了。

lines.en: : It’s like I just woke up one day and started a brand new life in a brand new body and just...went from there.
lines.zh: : 就像某天我一觉醒来，在一具全新的身体里开始了全新的人生，然后就……这么过下去了。

lines.en: scene nikidinner11
: You’re going to be okay.
lines.zh: : 你会没事的。

lines.en: : You’re still you.
lines.zh: : 你还是你。

lines.en: scene nikidinner12
: Something similar happened to me before, you know.
lines.zh: : 类似的事以前也发生在我身上，你知道吧。

lines.en: : I never told anyone about it because I was worried it would make me sound crazy.
lines.zh: : 我从没告诉过任何人，因为我怕说出来会显得我疯了。

lines.en: : But there were a lot of days where I woke up and felt sorta...disconnected from the world.
lines.zh: : 但有那么很多天，我醒来时会觉得有点……和这个世界脱了节。

lines.en: : Like I was also just a visitor in my own body.
lines.zh: : 就像我也只是自己身体里的一个过客。

lines.en: : I think I even tried convincing myself that you never existed a few times because it would have made everything a whole lot easier.
lines.zh: : 我有几次甚至试着说服自己：你根本就不曾存在过——因为那样一切都会简单得多。

lines.en: : It’s really hard to get mad at someone after they go through a tragedy and isolate themselves, but like...it’s hard to {i}not{/i} get mad, too.
lines.zh: : 一个人经历了悲剧之后把自己封闭起来，你很难真的对他生气；可是……也很难{i}不{/i}生气。

lines.en: : I wanted to be there for you and you clearly didn’t want me to do that.
lines.zh: : 我想陪在你身边，而你显然不想要我陪。

lines.en: : And it got really bad at points.
lines.zh: : 有几次真的很糟。

lines.en: : I lost sleep.
lines.zh: : 我失眠。

lines.en: : I heard things.
lines.zh: : 我听见一些声音。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I even started hallucinating at some points.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定自己有几次甚至出现了幻觉。

lines.en: : Looking back on it, though. They could have just been dreams.
lines.zh: : 不过现在回头看，那些也可能只是梦。

lines.en: : You really did a number on me when you left.
lines.zh: : 你离开的时候，真的把我伤得很重。

lines.en: : So I just did what any heartbroken girl would do to fix it.
lines.zh: : 所以我就做了任何一个心碎的女孩都会做的事，来修补它。

lines.en: : I stayed in bed. Cried a lot. Gained weight.
lines.zh: : 我赖在床上。哭了很多。变胖了。

lines.en: : Starved myself. Lost weight. Cried a lot more.
lines.zh: : 然后饿自己。瘦下来。又哭得更多。

lines.en: scene nikidinner13
: I thought about killing myself too.
lines.zh: : 我也想过自杀。

lines.en: : Not cause I wanted to die, though. I think I just wanted to teach you a lesson.
lines.zh: : 不过不是因为我想死。我想我只是想给你一个教训。

lines.en: : To show you that you’re a selfish asshole and that other people are able to think and feel too.
lines.zh: : 想让你看看，你是个自私的混蛋，而别人也是会思考、会感受的。

lines.en: : But I’m smart and awesome, so eventually I just realized that I was tying too much of my self-worth to you.
lines.zh: : 但我又聪明又了不起，所以最后我总算想明白了：我把太多自我价值绑在你身上了。

lines.en: : And that I didn’t need you to exist.
lines.zh: : 而我不需要靠你才能存在。

lines.en: : So I stopped starving myself and staying in bed and started training to become the best possible version of myself that I could be.
lines.zh: : 于是我不再饿自己、不再赖在床上，开始训练，把自己打造成我能做到的最好的版本。

lines.en: scene nikidinner9
: And now I’m famous and cute and you’re a loser so HA.
lines.zh: : 而现在我又红又可爱，你是个废物，所以哈。

lines.en: : And to think we could have avoided all of that if you’d just told me my age.
lines.zh: : 想想看，要是你当初直接告诉我我多大，这一切本来都可以避免的。

lines.en: scene nikidinner14
: Nah. It feels good to get all that off my chest.
lines.zh: : 不。把这些全倒出来，感觉挺好的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll do the same when you realize that you’re just subconsciously hiding your memories, and that they’re not gone forever.
lines.zh: : 我相信等你意识到自己只是在潜意识里把记忆藏了起来、而它们并没有永远消失的时候，你也会有同感。

lines.en: : Maybe. And all of that sounds plausible...but there’s one glaring mistake.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。你说的这些听起来都挺有道理……但有一个刺眼的错误。

lines.en: scene nikidinner15
: Mistake? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 错误？你在说什么？

lines.en: : That doesn’t explain the time loops.
lines.zh: : 那解释不了时间循环。

lines.en: : Are you high?
lines.zh: : 你嗑药了？

lines.en: I knew her explanation was too good to be true.
lines.zh: 我就知道她的解释好得不像真的。

lines.en: It was too convenient.
lines.zh: 太巧了。

lines.en: It’s one thing to dwell and break over a tragedy in your life. And sadness can manifest in so many ways.
lines.zh: 沉溺于人生中的一场悲剧、并为之崩溃，是一回事。而悲伤能以无数种方式显现出来。

lines.en: Niki knows that well.
lines.zh: 这一点 Niki 再清楚不过。

lines.en: But what it {i}can’t{/i} do is toss you into a repeating[school] year where everyone’s memory of time itself is wiped clean every few months, but their interpersonal memories remain.
lines.zh: 但悲伤{i}做不到{/i}的是，把你扔进一个不断重复的[school]年——在那里，每个人对时间本身的记忆每隔几个月就被抹得一干二净，可他们之间的人际记忆却留了下来。

lines.en: It's not just me that's broken. The {i}world{/i} is broken.
lines.zh: 坏掉的不只是我。是这个{i}世界{/i}坏了。

lines.en: Everything ever is broken.
lines.zh: 一切的一切都坏了。

lines.en: And the kind, honest words of a girl who used to love me are not going to change that.
lines.zh: 而一个曾经爱过我的女孩说出的那些善良、诚实的话，改变不了这一点。

lines.en: : I’m glad you opened up. But I still think what I’m going through is slightly different.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你愿意敞开心扉。但我还是觉得，我正在经历的事稍微有点不一样。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re not just being a selfish asshole again? You’ve always been good at that.
lines.zh: : 你确定自己不是又在当那个自私的混蛋了？你一向很拿手。

lines.en: : Not {i}entirely{/i} sure, but pretty sure. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 不{i}完全{/i}确定，但相当确定。是的。

lines.en: : So what are you going to do then? Give up on the past entirely or try and do something to get it back?
lines.zh: : 那你打算怎么办？彻底放弃过去，还是试着做点什么把它找回来？

lines.en: : Good question.
lines.zh: : 好问题。

lines.en: : Maybe I should just become an idol too?
lines.zh: : 也许我也该去当偶像？

lines.en: : Holy fuck, you really {i}are{/i} high.
lines.zh: : 我操，你{i}真的{/i}嗑药了。

lines.en: : How long have you been hooked?
lines.zh: : 你上瘾多久了？

lines.en: : It was a joke, Niki.
lines.zh: : 那是开玩笑，Niki。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I buy that. Memory loss...delusion...those are textbook symptoms of addiction.
lines.zh: : 我可不一定信。失忆……妄想……这些都是成瘾的典型症状。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: : So you’re really not going to tell me how old I am?
lines.zh: : 所以你真的不肯告诉我我多大？

lines.en: scene nikidinner16
: Why do you keep asking me that pointless question? Knowing your age will change literally nothing.
lines.zh: : 你为什么一直问这个毫无意义的问题？知道你的年纪根本改变不了任何事。

lines.en: : What if it sparks a chain reaction that gives me all of my memories back?
lines.zh: : 万一它引发一连串反应，把我的记忆全都还给我呢？

lines.en: : We’d be one step closer to your apology.
lines.zh: : 那样我们就离你的道歉更近一步了。

lines.en: scene nikidinner17
: You’re 31.
: Now shut up and stop asking me stupid questions.
lines.zh: : 现在闭嘴，别再问我蠢问题了。

lines.en: Wow. I guess my original guess wasn’t that far off.
lines.zh: 哇。看来我最初猜的也没差太远。

lines.en: I’m a little younger than I thought, but Niki is-
lines.zh: 我比自己想的年轻一点，不过 Niki——

lines.en: : Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : If I’m 31...and you’re two years younger than me-
lines.zh: : 如果我 31……而你比我小两岁——

lines.en: scene nikidinner18
: Don’t remind me! I’m practically six feet underground already!
lines.zh: : 别提醒我！我都快埋到六英尺以下了！

lines.en: : I wasted basically my entire 20’s on you and now you apparently don’t even remember your age!
lines.zh: : 我基本上把整个二十多岁都浪费在你身上了，而现在你居然连自己的年纪都不记得！

lines.en: : You look...really good for 29.
lines.zh: : 你看起来……以 29 岁来说真的很好。

lines.en: : Of course I do!
lines.zh: : 那是当然！

lines.en: : It’s hard to {i}not{/i} look good when you burn six trillion calories a week!
lines.zh: : 一周烧掉六万亿卡路里，想{i}不{/i}好看都难！

lines.en: : From the moment I wake up until the moment I go to bed it’s just training, training, training.
lines.zh: : 从我睁眼的那一刻到我上床的那一刻，就只有训练、训练、训练。

lines.en: scene nikidinner19
: But...thanks, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不过……谢了，大概吧。

lines.en: : You look good, too.
lines.zh: : 你看起来也不错。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you’re almost 30 years old and you look like that.
lines.zh: : 真不敢相信你都快 30 岁了，看起来还是这样。

lines.en: scene nikidinner20
: Shut. Your. Fucking. Mouth.
lines.zh: : 闭。上。你。他妈的。嘴。

lines.en: : Friend! Cotton Candy Girl! How are the soggy wheat strings that you have yet to consume?
lines.zh: : 朋友！棉花糖女孩！你们那还没吃完的湿软麦线怎么样了？

lines.en: scene nikidinner21
: Fine, Kaori. Thanks for checking in on us.
lines.zh: : 挺好的，Kaori。谢谢你来照看我们。

lines.en: : The manager asked that I come rain silence upon you as Cotton Candy Girl’s vocal chords are extremely strong!
lines.zh: : 店长让我过来给你们降下寂静，因为棉花糖女孩的声带极其有力！

lines.en: : Probably from being an idol or whatever. Has she mentioned that to you yet?
lines.zh: : 大概是因为当偶像什么的。她跟你提过这个了吗？

lines.en: : Many times! But I have yet to see her in the picture box!
lines.zh: : 提过很多次！可我还没在那个画面盒子里见过她！

lines.en: : Watch closer! I’m there! All the time! It’s not a joke!
lines.zh: : 看仔细点！我在里面！一直都在！这不是开玩笑！

lines.en: : Friend. Can you tell me how you feel about hard circle lizards?
lines.zh: : 朋友。你能告诉我你对硬壳圆形蜥蜴是什么感觉吗？

lines.en: : Turtles? I think they’re okay.
lines.zh: : 乌龟？我觉得还行吧。

lines.en: : Can this wait until next time, though? Niki and I are in the middle of a conversation.
lines.zh: : 不过这个能留到下次再说吗？我和 Niki 正在谈话。

lines.en: : Yes! I will send you pictures of a good circle turtle tonight!
lines.zh: : 好的！我今晚就给你发一只好看的圆龟的照片！

lines.en: : Just a turtle, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 就是乌龟，Kaori。

lines.en: : I understand!
lines.zh: : 我明白了！

lines.en: : Hello!
lines.zh: : 你好！

lines.en: scene nikidinner22
Kaori leaves just as quickly as she appeared and I find myself once again talking to someone that I can confirm is a human.
lines.zh: Kaori 来得快去得也快，我又一次发现自己在和一个我能确认是人类的人说话。

lines.en: : She’s a lot cuter when she’s not asking if we’ve had sex before.
lines.zh: : 她不问我们有没有上过床的时候，可爱多了。

lines.en: : Do you want her number?
lines.zh: : 你想要她号码吗？

lines.en: : Depends. Do you think she’d have any interest in becoming an idol?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你觉得她会有兴趣当偶像吗？

lines.en: : Kaori?
lines.zh: : Kaori？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Like, {i}that{/i} Kaori?
lines.zh: : {i}那个{/i} Kaori？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think she’d be good.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得她会很不错。

lines.en: : {i}Kaori?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Kaori？{/i}

lines.en: scene nikidinner23
: I figured you’d have a bit more faith in her, {i}Friend{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你对她会更有信心一点呢，{i}朋友{/i}。

lines.en: : I do, but...
lines.zh: : 我是有信心，不过……

lines.en: : {i}Kaori?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Kaori？{/i}

lines.en: : She’s on her feet all hours of the day. She’s got a nice figure. And heterochromia is highly fetishized for whatever reason, so she’d definitely sell.
lines.zh: : 她一天到晚都站着。身材也好。而且异色瞳不知道为什么特别受追捧，所以她绝对卖得动。

lines.en: : She also has a gigantic spider tattoo on her chest.
lines.zh: : 她胸口还纹了一只巨大的蜘蛛。

lines.en: scene nikidinner24
: You’ve seen her chest?
lines.zh: : 你见过她胸口？

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re understanding. It’s a {i}big{/i} fucking spider.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没听懂。那是一只很{i}大{/i}的蜘蛛。

lines.en: : Why on earth would she do that?
lines.zh: : 她到底是为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : Because she’s Kaori. Just leave it at that.
lines.zh: : 因为她是 Kaori。就这么着吧。

lines.en: : Why her anyway? Is your agency desperate for idols or something?
lines.zh: : 话说为什么是她？你们事务所是缺偶像缺到什么地步了吗？

lines.en: scene nikidinner25
: That’s not it.
lines.zh: : 不是那么回事。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : Do you remember the first time we went to karaoke together?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我们第一次一起去唱卡拉 OK 吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不记得。

lines.en: scene nikidinner26
: Oh. Right.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。

lines.en: : Well, basically, I was super nervous about singing in front of you. But you talked me into it and then told me I was great afterward.
lines.zh: : 嗯，总之，我当时特别紧张，不敢在你面前唱。可你说服了我，之后还说我唱得很好。

lines.en: : So you’re naturally talented. Good for you.
lines.zh: : 所以你天生有天赋。挺好的。

lines.en: : Oh, no. You totally lied. I was horrible.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。你完全是在撒谎。我唱得烂透了。

lines.en: : But something clicked in me when I was singing and, even though I sucked, it felt liberating. I really loved it.
lines.zh: : 但我在唱歌的时候，心里有什么东西咔哒一声对上了——就算我唱得很烂，那感觉却很自由。我真的很喜欢。

lines.en: : So I wound up taking lessons and, once I figured out how to control my voice, it changed everything.
lines.zh: : 于是我去上了课，而一旦我弄明白怎么控制自己的声音，一切就都变了。

lines.en: : I didn’t have to be nervous anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不用再紧张了。

lines.en: scene nikidinner27
: I just think it would be nice being able to help girls over that same hurdle.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，能帮别的女孩跨过同一道坎，会挺好的。

lines.en: : So you’re a famous idol, but...you want to be a vocal coach?
lines.zh: : 所以你是知名偶像，却……想当声乐教练？

lines.en: scene nikidinner28
: Who says I can’t do both?
lines.zh: : 谁说我不能两个都做？

lines.en: : News flash, but I’m kind of amazing.
lines.zh: : 告诉你个新闻，我可是相当了不起的。

lines.en: : I’ve already got one girl under my wing and she’s gonna be totally huge one day. Mark my words.
lines.zh: : 我手下已经有一个女孩了，她总有一天会彻底大红大紫。记住我的话。

lines.en: : Super cute, too. She’s the whole package.
lines.zh: : 而且超级可爱。她要什么有什么。

lines.en: : You’re just talking about your sister, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你说的该不会就是你妹妹吧？

lines.en: scene nikidinner29
: What, Noriko? She wouldn’t be caught dead singing anything that doesn’t sound like it’s filtered through a five dollar guitar amp.
lines.zh: : 什么，Noriko？她死都不会唱任何听起来不像是从五美元的吉他音箱里过滤出来的东西。

lines.en: : My girl is friends with her, though. Her name is Otoha.
lines.zh: : 不过我那个女孩跟她是朋友。她叫 Otoha。

lines.en: : Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : Woah what? Why woah?
lines.zh: : 哇哦什么？为什么哇哦？

lines.en: : How many rings does she wear?
lines.zh: : 她戴几枚戒指？

lines.en: : A lot. Why?
lines.zh: : 很多。怎么了？

lines.en: : I know her.
lines.zh: : 我认识她。

lines.en: : Why do you know a [teenage]girl from a[school] you don’t teach at?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会认识一个你不任教的[school]里的[teenage]女孩？

lines.en: : One of my students has a crush on her.
lines.zh: : 我的一个学生暗恋她。

lines.en: : This is a really weird coincidence.
lines.zh: : 这真是巧得离谱。

lines.en: : It really is. I had no idea you were the sketchy basement girl.
lines.zh: : 确实是。我都不知道你就是那个“可疑地下室女孩”。

lines.en: scene nikidinner30
: Well...the...the agency doesn’t want me...teaching classes so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……事务所……不希望我……开班授课，所以……

lines.en: : I had to pick somewhere...secret...
lines.zh: : 我得挑个……隐蔽点的地方……

lines.en: : And you just happened to choose a sketchy basement.
lines.zh: : 然后你就偏偏挑了个可疑的地下室。

lines.en: scene nikidinner31
: It was all I could find...
lines.zh: : 我能找到的就只有那个了……

lines.en: : I’m...still looking for somewhere else...
lines.zh: : 我……还在找别的地方……

lines.en: : Either way, it’s nice to know you’re following your dreams. Just don’t let it get in the way of the thing that’s actually making you money.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，知道你在追寻梦想挺好的。只是别让它妨碍了真正在给你赚钱的那件事。

lines.en: scene nikidinner32
: Obviously. But thanks for the advice, anyway.
lines.zh: : 那是当然。不过还是谢谢你的建议。

lines.en: : Do you want me to say hi to Otoha for you?
lines.zh: : 要我替你跟 Otoha 问好吗？

lines.en: : Nah. I’m sure I’ll be seeing her again sometime.
lines.zh: : 不用。我肯定什么时候会再见到她的。

lines.en: : That’s not a creepy thing to say at all.
lines.zh: : 这话一点都不变态呢。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be hearing plenty more borderline creepy things from me in the future, so you might as well get used to it now.
lines.zh: : 我敢保证，将来你还会从我这儿听到更多游走在变态边缘的话，所以你不如现在就习惯起来。

lines.en: scene black
Niki and I finish our dinner and talk a little more about her life as an idol...and how weird it was for her to blow up out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 我和 Niki 吃完了饭，又聊了聊她当偶像的生活……以及她一夜爆红这件事有多离奇。

lines.en: It feels kind of surreal, to be honest-
lines.zh: 说实话，感觉有点超现实——

lines.en: Having someone so...established acting so familiar with me.
lines.zh: 有这么一个……已经功成名就的人，对我这么熟稔。

lines.en: Like nothing has changed even after all she’s been through.
lines.zh: 仿佛她经历了这一切之后，什么都没变过。

lines.en: Like it’s any other day...
lines.zh: 仿佛这就是再平常不过的一天……

lines.en: scene nikidinner33
: I like this place. We should come back.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢这家店。我们该再来。

lines.en: : Are you going to pay next time?
lines.zh: : 下次你请？

lines.en: : What? No. Why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 什么？不。我为什么要请？

lines.en: : Because you’re rich?
lines.zh: : 因为你很有钱？

lines.en: : I’m probably not as rich as you think.
lines.zh: : 我大概没你想的那么有钱。

lines.en: : You’re paying every single time until you apologize for destroying my heart.
lines.zh: : 在你为毁掉我的心道歉之前，每一次都由你请。

lines.en: : I agreed to paying for breakfast, but dinner as well is just-
lines.zh: : 早餐我请是答应了，可连晚餐也算上就——

lines.en: scene nikidinner34
: You owe me~
lines.zh: : 你欠我的~

lines.en: : How about I get you a punch card?
lines.zh: : 那我给你办张集点卡怎么样？

lines.en: : Buy me ten meals and I might even let you hold my hand.
lines.zh: : 请我吃十顿，我说不定还会让你牵我的手。

lines.en: : What could I get for twenty meals?
lines.zh: : 那二十顿能换到什么？

lines.en: scene nikidinner35
: We can discuss that once you get there.
lines.zh: : 等你到了那一步我们再讨论。

$ niki_love += 1
{i}Niki’s affection has increased to [niki_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Niki 的好感度提升到了 [niki_love]!{/i}

lines.zh: {i}你收到了一条来自 Kaori 的新彩信！{/i}
